# 214 — External_CallCompleted

Indicates that an external operation delegate returned normally\.

[All events](index.md) · [External category](Category_External.md) · [API reference](xref:Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents.ExternalEvents.CallCompleted%28System.String%2CSystem.String%2CSystem.String%29)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| EventId | 214 |
| Name | External_CallCompleted |
| Category | [External](Category_External.md) |
| Event class | OperationalInformation |
| Log level | Information |
| Status | Stable |
| Introduced | 0.0.11 |

## Usage

Import `Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents`. This example assumes an existing
`ILogger` named `logger` and caller-supplied variables for the arguments.

```csharp
logger.External.CallCompleted(@externalName, @operationName, @operationId);
```

**Trigger:** Emit immediately after the operation returns normally, before interpreting or using its result\.

**Message template:** External dependency \{ExternalName\} operation completed\. Operation: \{OperationName\}\. Attempt: \{OperationId\}\.

## Arguments

- `externalName` (`string`): The logical dependency name, without credentials or request\-specific data\.
- `operationName` (`string`): The logical name of the external operation\.
- `operationId` (`string`): The identifier of this individual operation attempt\. Use a different identifier for each retry\.

## Remarks

- Normal completion does not establish business success\. The returned value may describe a rejection or other unsuccessful outcome\.
- An exception or observed cancellation prevents this completion event\.
- Use the same external name, operation name, and operation identifier as External\_Calling\.
- This event does not establish application recovery or guarantee future dependency availability\.
- Calling this method only emits a diagnostic record\. It does not perform the operation or inspect its result\.
